mechanism: Ciprofloxacin may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of primaquine and both drugs can cause QT prolongation; primaquine also carries risk of hemolysis in G6PD-deficient patients requiring careful monitoring.
action: Monitor for QT prolongation on ECG, ensure G6PD status is known before primaquine use, and consider alternative antibiotics if possible; if combination necessary, monitor for adverse effects including hemolytic anemia.
